mapper.select: SELECT u.id as teacherId, u.username as teacherName, COUNT(ch.id) as homeworkCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as publishedCount FROM course_homework ch LEFT JOIN user u ON ch.create_user = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.username ORDER BY homeworkCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.id as courseId, c.title as courseName, COUNT(ch.id) as homeworkCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as publishedCount FROM course_homework ch LEFT JOIN course c ON ch.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.title ORDER BY homeworkCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(id) as homeworkCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as publishedCount FROM course_homework WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT COUNT(id) as totalHomework, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as publishedHomework, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draftHomework, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as todayHomework FROM course_homework
